audit_cleanNodes: Remove unused units of an import
import_hint: Bring people in from a spreadsheet you already have. Units named in it are created along the way
upload_rule: One .xlsx file of up to 2000 rows; a header row, then one person per row
sheet_headerRowHint: The row holding the column titles; the rows under it are people
sheet_noHeaders: No column titles on this row
mapping_userTypeHint: Everyone in this file gets the same type
mapping_anchorHint: Every row stands under this unit; the levels below come from the file
mapping_levelsHint: One column per level, in any order. Units that do not exist yet are created; every row must fill every level
mapping_anchorSaid: Everyone stands under {path}; the levels below come from the file
mapping_example: The first row, as it will land
mapping_exampleUnready: Choose the columns to see where the first row lands
preview_errors: {count, plural, one {# row needs fixing} other {# rows need fixing}}
preview_issuesHint: Fix the file and upload it again; nothing is imported while a row is wrong
issue_orgNameTooLong: A unit name is too long
issue_controlCharacter: A cell holds a line break or an invisible character
issue_tooManyCells: The workbook holds more cells than one import reads. Delete the sheets and rows you are not importing
issue_notXlsx: The file is not an .xlsx workbook. Save it as .xlsx and upload it again
issue_fileTooLarge: The file is too large to import. Split it, or delete what you are not importing
issue_tooManySheets: The workbook has too many sheets. Keep only the one you are importing
issue_sheetMissing: The chosen sheet is not in the file. Choose another
issue_tooManyRows: The sheet has more rows than one import reads. Split it into several files
issue_tooManyColumns: The sheet has too many columns. Delete the ones you are not importing
issue_cellTooLong: {cell, select, none {A cell} other {Cell {cell}}} holds more text than a field takes
issue_formulaNotAllowed: {cell, select, none {A cell} other {Cell {cell}}} holds a formula. Paste the sheet as values and upload it again
issue_cellError: {cell, select, none {A cell} other {Cell {cell}}} shows an error value such as #N/A. Correct it and upload again
issue_headerRowOutOfRange: The header row is past the end of the sheet. Check the row number
issue_unreadable: The file could not be opened. Make sure it is an intact .xlsx workbook
issue_userConflict: This {businessNo} belongs to somebody already, with a different {fields}
issue_nodeTypeConflict: {path} exists as a unit of another type
preview_commitCount: Import {count, plural, one {# person} other {# people}}
done_summary: {users, plural, one {# person} other {# people}} and {nodes, plural, =0 {no units} one {# unit} other {# units}} created
done_existing: {count, plural, one {# person was already here} other {# people were already here}}, left as they are
done_kept: This import is kept as a record: what it did row by row, and the ways to take it back.
prep_people: One person to a row, with a column for their name and one for their {businessNo}
prep_units: Optionally a column for each level of unit they stand in, such as college, year and class. Units that do not exist yet are created
prep_header: A header row naming the columns, which need not be the first row. Which column is which is chosen in the next steps
prep_existing: Somebody whose {businessNo} already exists is left as they are, and nothing is written before you confirm the check
record_undoHint: Reversing deletes the people it created; cleaning removes the units it created that stand empty
record_undoElsewhere: Reversing an import and cleaning its units are done on a computer
countOf: {count, plural, one {# in all} other {# in all}}
records_hint: Every import is kept, with what it did and what became of the people
records_failed: Past imports could not be loaded
record_counts: {users, plural, one {# person created} other {# people created}}, {existing} already present, {nodes, plural, =0 {no units} one {# unit} other {# units}} created
record_hiddenRows: {count, plural, one {# more row is} other {# more rows are}} outside the units you manage
record_hiddenNodes: {count, plural, one {# more unit is} other {# more units are}} outside the units you manage
record_failed: The import could not be loaded
reverse_title: Delete the people this import created?
reverse_hint: {count, plural, one {# person} other {# people}} created by this import will be deleted; {bindings} have sign-in credentials and {grants} hold roles today. Records they took part in are kept.
reverse_nothing: Nobody from this import is left to delete
reverse_done: {retired, plural, one {# person} other {# people}} deleted
clean_title: Remove the units this import created?
clean_hint: Only units nobody uses go; a unit with people or sub-units stays and is listed
event_reversed: Reversed: {count, plural, one {# person} other {# people}} deleted
error_invalid: The file cannot be imported as it is.
error_mappingInvalid: The columns do not describe a valid set of units.
error_planChanged: Something changed since the check. Check the file again.
error_sourceUnavailable: The uploaded file is no longer available. Upload it again.
error_busy: Other files are being read right now. Try again in a moment.
error_sourceUsed: This file was already imported. Upload it again to import it once more.
error_lastAdministrator: The tenant would be left without an administrator who can still sign in.
